bullets.text: Accenture Acquires COMWARE — Accenture is acquiring COMWARE to enhance its digital transformation services for mid-market companies in Japan, adding over 180 professionals with expertise in IT and SAP.
Accenture Acquires McCoy — The acquisition of McCoy will bolster Accenture's SAP capabilities and AI innovation, further supporting mid-market clients in the Netherlands and EMEA region.
Focus on Mid-Market Growth — Both acquisitions aim to strengthen Accenture Edge's offerings, helping mid-market companies modernize operations and integrate AI into their business processes.
Enhanced SAP Expertise — McCoy's expertise in SAP solutions will provide Accenture with advanced tools and methodologies, improving service delivery for clients in various sectors.

Strategic AI Integration — The combined capabilities from COMWARE and McCoy will enable faster, more efficient AI-driven transformations for clients, enhancing competitiveness in their respective markets.
